# Shepherd's Old Field Market (SOF Market)

> A two-floor local makers market in Leonardtown, Maryland, with over 90 locally owned shops and services, eateries and a beer garden, inside the former Leonardtown Building Supply on Duke Street. Opened in 2018.

## Contact

- Address: 22725 Duke Street, Leonardtown, MD 20650 (in the heart of Leonardtown, St. Mary's County)
- Phone: (240) 309-4067
- Email: shepherdsoldfieldmarket@gmail.com
- Vendor enquiries: MarketingSOFMarket@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Shepherdsoldfield
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/shepherds_old_field_market/
- Brudergarten Beer Garden: https://www.brudergarten.com

## Market hours

- Tuesday to Saturday: 10 AM to 7 PM
- Sunday: 11 AM to 5 PM
- Monday: closed

## Brudergarten Beer Garden hours

- Tuesday to Thursday: 4 PM to 10 PM
- Friday and Saturday: 11 AM to 1 AM
- Sunday: 11 AM to 7 PM
- Monday: closed

## The building

The former Leonardtown Building Supply, about 9,000 square feet on two floors. It sat empty for years until the market opened in 2018, keeping its red brick floors and rough-sawn wood walls. Booths are built like little cottages with tin roofs.

## Food and drink

- Brudergarten Beer Garden: 20 beers on tap, local craft beers, flights, wine and cocktails. Bavarian pretzels, bratwurst, charcuterie. Snookball, Extreme Jenga, badminton and cornhole in the yard. Hosts private events.
- Botanic Deli and Cafe: fresh salads, handcrafted sandwiches, seasonal soups, vegetarian and vegan options.
- Bowl 29: fusion bowls.
- Juice Buzz.

## Services

- Olde Towne Barbershop: private one-on-one appointments, men's and children's cuts.
- Ribshot Tattoo.
- Leonardtown Music Service: lessons for all ages in guitar, piano, drums and more, instrument sales, tutoring, piano tuning and moving.
- Reflexology with Ruth.

## Events

- Wednesdays: Trivia Night at Brudergarten, 7 PM to 9 PM, indoors, teams of 2 to 6.
- Thursdays: Karaoke Night at Brudergarten.
- First Friday Weekend Sales: the first weekend of each month that includes a Friday, sales at select stores throughout the market.

## Sell at SOF Market

A few spaces are available for unique product lines not already offered in the market. Email MarketingSOFMarket@gmail.com with a description of your product.
